kishore.k: Kicking off MedAtlas POC scoping thread. Need to prioritize product search use cases, clarify success metrics, and surface any enterprise blockers before our SOW.

emily.r: From our side: 1) Retrieval-augmented search for clinician queries (ranked snippets), 2) Redaction + linkage for patient PDF ingestion, 3) API for programmatic batch summarization. Which should be in the MVP POC?

toni.p (MedAtlas): Top two for us are search and PDF ingestion. Summarization is nice-to-have. Important: results must include provenance (doc ID + snippet offsets) and confidence score. Success = 80% top-1 accuracy on retrieval bench, <10% false-positive redactions, end-to-end latency for search <200ms p95.

secops-liaison-bot: Security items: need DPA + BAA for PHI, approved encryption (KMS), network isolation (VPC peering), and an inventory of any third-party LLMs. Also request for penetration test history. Expect 7-10 days for questionnaire turnaround.

sam.ae: Pricing note: for heavy retrieval workloads with embeddings, embeddings cost dominates. Estimate: 500k embedding units/month ~ $Y (hosted). We can pilot on hosted but for performance/DPA likely Dedicated or Private. I'll prepare two price scenarios.

emily.r: For evaluations: propose 150 queries for retrieval bench, 200 pages for PDF pipeline tests. We'll need sample PDFs with a mix of scanned images and native text. Toni, can you provide samples?

toni.p (MedAtlas): Yes — will share 250 PDFs (sanitized) and a small golden set with labeled spans. Also require SAML SSO and SCIM for provisioning during the POC.

kishore.k: Proposed endpoints: /search-rag, /pdf-ingest (async job + webhook), /batch-summarize. Also need webhook retry semantics and idempotency keys documented in API.

emily.r: I'll add webhook best-practices to the POC runbook and include sample payload. Also will provide a 3-page onboarding checklist for network + SSO setup.

secops-liaison-bot: Add-on: for PDF images we'll need OCR pipeline details and whether OCR occurs client-side or by Redwood. If Redwood runs OCR, ensure OCR output retained for audit or provide option to disable.

sam.ae: Action items: 1) I'll send price scenarios by tomorrow, 2) Emily to share runbook + prompt templates, 3) Toni to upload PDFs + network contact, 4) Sec ops to send questionnaire.

emily.r: Proposed timeline: Week 0 legal & security signoff; Week 1 data ingest + SSO; Week 2 model tuning & embedding index build; Week 3 internal bench + performance tuning; Week 4 customer evals + feedback; Week 5 hardening + decision. Any objections?

toni.p (MedAtlas): Works but need network review earlier (Week 0) due to procurement windows.

kishore.k: Noted. We'll prioritize security questionnaire completion. Schedule 30m call Friday to confirm network diagram owner.

emily.r: Sample curl for async PDF ingest (replace URL/KEY):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/pdf/ingest \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \ 
  -F "file=@patient_report.pdf" \ 
  -F "metadata={\"patient_id\":\"abc123\"}"
```

sam.ae: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the pricing email and the SOW template.

toni.p (MedAtlas): Thanks team. We'll prep the PDFs and security contact info. :raised_hands:
